definition: Selects, from a catalogue of Earth observation products, those of a collection whose footprint intersects an area of interest and whose acquisition time falls within a time interval, possibly filtered further on their metadata, such as their cloud cover.

hasAction.description: The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/product-selection to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/product-selection, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/product-selection/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
